name: Operation Silent Corridor
summary: After Mountain Shield, the task force escorts the recovered Falcon-2 crew and supplies down the valley corridor to Gardun's South Gate and sets up the staging area for the assault on the city.

states.objective: Briefing: move the Falcon-2 crew and supplies from Checkpoint Echo to Gardun's South Gate.
Form up the convoy: Warden-1 leads, Nomad-1 carries the Falcon-2 crew, Nomad-2 carries supplies.
Fly Raven ahead and place Relay Kilo on the valley shoulder so the drone link reaches the corridor.
Scout the corridor with Raven and mark what's ahead before the convoy moves.
Advance the convoy down the main road.
Communications outage: the drone link is jammed. Send a squad to restore Relay Kilo.
The bridge ahead is blocked. Detour the whole convoy through the Dry Riverbed, or send infantry through the river drainage tunnel to clear the far bank.
Take the convoy down the Dry Riverbed. Expect an ambush in the narrows: repel it and keep Nomad-1 alive.
Infantry only: move through the drainage tunnel and clear the far bank while the convoy holds.
Warden-1 pushes the wreck off the bridge. Bring the convoy across.
Reach South Gate and clear the staging yard.
Set up the forward staging area for the Gardun assault.
Corridor secured. The whole convoy reached South Gate.
Corridor secured, but part of the convoy was lost. Fewer reinforcements for the assault.
The Falcon-2 crew transport was lost. Restart from the last checkpoint.
